scope: commercial name, public discoverability, game-store collision reconnaissance, trademark and domain preflight

rounds.result: no exact game/app collision surfaced in indexed web/store reconnaissance

queries: exact phrase scoped to public INPI-indexed pages
exact phrase scoped to WIPO-indexed pages
rounds.result: no exact indexed game/app/software collision or exact official indexed registry result surfaced; returned pages used the words veredas/trama in unrelated generic or literary contexts

public_reconnaissance.note: Search-engine/store reconnaissance is only an early collision screen. It cannot exclude confusingly similar marks, unindexed records, figurative marks or records visible only through interactive registries.

official_methodology_evidence.inpi: A final decision requires an interactive exact/similar search in the relevant Brazilian trademark classes and review of material candidates.
official_methodology_evidence.wipo: A final decision requires a human Global Brand Database/national-regional cross-check; no automated result is represented as an official registry clearance.
official_methodology_evidence.automation_boundary: No claim of INPI/WIPO clearance is made from public search-engine indexing.

completion_requirements: complete exact and confusingly-similar human search in INPI classes relevant to downloadable game software and entertainment services
complete WIPO/global human cross-check and record material candidates if any
confirm desired domains/social handles or explicitly accept alternatives
record final name decision and trademark filing strategy or explicit no-filing decision
